hints.title: Monotonic Inversion Count
hints.text: As the separation threshold increases, the count of satisfying inversion pairs monotonically increases.

hints.title: Interval Bounded Counting
hints.text: For a fixed threshold candidate, count pairs where the right element lies within the required difference window.

hints.title: Fenwick Tree Inversion Counting
hints.text: Maintain previously seen elements in an index tree to query frequency bounds for each step.

complexity.notes: Binary search on monotonic threshold combined with pair counting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all possible threshold values sequentially requires testing every distinct difference.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct comparison evaluates threshold conditions without large memory buffers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize monotonicity with respect to threshold to apply binary search.
